mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with higher wage pressures and potential inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases do not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 2%, it indicates a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified interaction does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, which is associated with economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified interaction does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals growing consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases do not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.
